description: This source file defines the 'DataEncryptor' class which provides methods for encrypting and decrypting data using AES-GCM encryption. It includes key derivation from a password using SHA-256.

classes.name: DataEncryptor
classes.description: A sealed class providing encryption and decryption functionalities using AES-GCM with password-derived keys.

methods.name: Encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts a plaintext string using a password, returning the IV, authentication tag, and ciphertext.

methods.name: Decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts ciphertext using IV, authentication tag, and password. Returns null on authentication failure.

methods.name: DeriveKey
methods.description: Generates a cryptographic key from a password using SHA-256 hashing.
